## What's new

Threadnote 4.7.7 makes OMP a first-class agent client, with profile-aware installation, repair, and cleanup.

### OMP agent integration

Use `threadnote mcp-install omp`, `threadnote install-hooks omp`, and `threadnote doctor` to install and maintain
Threadnote for OMP alongside the existing agent clients. Threadnote now writes its MCP configuration, instructions,
skills, and hooks to the active OMP profile or `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`, preserving the exact configured host root for
later repair and removal.

Changing profiles or custom roots moves managed OMP artifacts safely, including hooks, without touching user-managed
files. Project-scoped OMP setups also repair correctly outside the default Threadnote home. Disabled Threadnote MCP
servers remain disabled during doctor checks, and OMP compaction hooks use OMP-safe state capture rather than
Claude-specific transcript handling.
